title: Desert Valley View
description: A person sees a wide open desert in the foreground with orange sand, dry bushes, and grasses. In the distance are large rocky mountains, green and yellow fields in a valley, and scattered trees under a bright white sky.
prompt: A wide desert valley scene with orange sand and dry bushes in the foreground, leading to green and yellow fields dotted with trees in the middle ground, surrounded by tall rocky mountains in shades of blue and gray, under a bright white sky, shown in a clean illustrative painting style.
